live_source_review: Codex assistant; no independent human evaluation
initial_product_bug: A 32-byte truncated PNG was accepted with HTTP 200. Recording stopped at that acceptance and is preserved as LaporSiap_Failed_1.mp4.
fixes: Decode PNG/JPEG completely after enforcing a 24-million-pixel limit.
Validate PDF header, EOF and basic xref pointer before storing.
Keep case, attachments and review revision unchanged on rejected uploads.
Display bilingual errors, scroll them into view and focus them.
Use valid PDF regression fixtures, synchronize source review, and enable browser test recording.

other_attempts.reason: Legacy smoke fixture contained only a PDF header; replaced by a valid PDF.
Video FFmpeg cache path missing; stopped suite and configured the already installed recorder cache.
New test enumerated checkboxes before the manual draft loaded; fixed explicit waits. App correctly kept confirmation disabled.

limitations: Network/provider UI faults are deliberately simulated, not observed real outages.
Backend tests verify real local HTTP provider-contract guards and the timeout path; there are no extra live provider calls.

PDF validation checks its envelope only; arbitrary malformed internal PDF objects/streams may still pass. No PDF rendering/readability guarantee, OCR, malware scan or evidence authenticity validation.
Image limit is 24 million pixels in addition to 5 MiB and ten attachments.
Unsaved input in the network scenario is preserved in the current tab, not promised to survive a reload.
A single source-injection success is not general prompt-injection resistance or an independent user study.
